provenance.note: RFC-401 T4 adds the platform-owned AtomicApply claim table. A history-0001 installation records one claim per apply journal; the seeded Intent apply is committed and its post-commit tail completed, so its claim carries tail_state complete with an expired lease. The add-table edge itself writes no rows: upgrading a history-0000 installation leaves the new table empty until the daemon claims or recovers a journal.
